## Why

Owner report 2026-10-27 (on c0848ab): with one project registered, + does nothing, so more projects cannot be added from the TUI. It is by design today: the add key is bound as "+ add project (Welcome)" (internal/tui/keys.go:64) and handled only in welcomeKey (internal/tui/welcome.go:86), which is reached only when no project is registered (internal/tui/model.go:461-466). docs/dashboard.md:52-53 says the add key works only on Welcome in this slice (S96).
